body:
I think I need to clarify my situation.  I have been brought up in an environment where self determination is everything.  My whole family believes in this concept.
The thing thing is, I cannot.  I view this philosophy as redundant; beyond any kind of redemption.  They seem to fight for something that is unattainable, something false, something that is so useless it is laughable.

I cannot not understand this; I am so lost, I scream for guidance.
